hero.title: Your trip, planned by AI.
hero.subtitle: Pick a destination and we draft a day-by-day itinerary from real places nearby — sights grouped by area, restaurants close to each stop and a hotel in the middle — shown on a satellite map.
hero.imageAlt: Traveller planning a trip with a map

form.title: Where do you want to go?

form.notePlaceholder: e.g. travelling with kids, love street food

form.loginToPlan: Sign in to plan your trip
form.chooseDestination: Please choose a destination from the list.
form.radius: How far are you willing to go?
